title: Student Class
description: Create `Student(name)` with `add_mark(mark)` and a read-only property `average` (0 when there are no marks). Give a property `grade`: `'A'` for average 80+, `'B'` for 60-79, `'C'` otherwise.

visible_tests.driver:
s = Student('Asha')
s.add_mark(90)
s.add_mark(70)
print(s.average, s.grade)
